product_one_liner.value: CloudTalk is an AI-powered business phone and voice-agent platform that helps small and mid-sized sales and support teams make and receive calls, automate conversations, and analyze customer interactions.

eng_blog.notes: The R&D posts cover testing, voice-infrastructure monitoring and technical backlog decisions; authors include CPTO Josef Lapka and engineering leader Jaroslav Tomeček. The site’s generic author footer labels Lapka “Senior Copywriter,” but the independent customer case study identifies him as CPTO.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The near-date vacancy snapshot, verified November 10, 2026, lists four openings and no qualifying AI/ML/data-science title. The previously advertised AI Researcher role was marked removed May 8, 2026. The official board is accessible but its vacancy titles are not exposed in the readable page.

model_provider.value: OpenAI; Anthropic; Google; AssemblyAI; ElevenLabs; Deepgram
model_provider.notes: The subprocessor list explicitly associates these providers with Conversation Intelligence, transcription, AI Voice Agent configuration or voice-agent processing.

compliance_certs.notes: Public claims include SOC 2 Type II and ISO/IEC 27001 certification, GDPR and HIPAA compliance, and PCI DSS merchant requirements through SAQ A 4.0; these are not all third-party certifications.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest verified funding announcement is January 17, 2024, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Sales Development Representative – Inbound, Barcelona; posting dated October 1, 2026.

launched_6mo.notes: The rebuilt AI Sales Dialer became available September 28, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026; features include multi-number dialing, fresh-contact prioritization, callbacks and AI voicemail detection.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No dated C-level or VP-level arrival or departure was verified for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026, and a complete, start-date-bearing leadership roster was unavailable. The VP Sales and VP People arrivals found were before the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting explicitly requires maintaining lead data in HubSpot CRM; this is direct evidence of internal use rather than merely offering an integration.
